topics.title: Coursework & Assessment
topics.summary: RWTH Aachen provides student access to RWTHgpt via KI:connect for study assistance, but individual course instructors determine whether generative AI is permitted in specific coursework assignments.

claims.text: RWTHgpt is made available to students via KI:connect, while permission to use AI in coursework assessments remains subject to instructor discretion.

evidence.quote: Since December 11, 2024, students are also able to use RWTHgpt. No separate role or activation is necessary for this.
evidence.title: The AI System RWTHgpt (Center for Teaching and Learning Services)

topics.title: Exams & In-Person Assessment
topics.summary: RWTH’s general examination regulations require independent work across forms of examination. Specific AI use rules for an examination must be checked separately.

evidence.quote:
Allerdings darf von Studierenden nicht verlangt werden, für eine Lehrveranstaltung
